text:
Irene: Quick shout  we just unlocked the 1-year target early and hit $12M ARR this quarter!! :tada: Couldn’t be prouder of the grit on infra + product.
Jamal: WHAT ❤❤❤ Huge congrats. also: who brought the confetti? :confetti_ball:
Priya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/happy-party-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIY (mandatory)
Leo: Small celebration plan: 10-min highlight at next all-hands, cake in SF hub, and 15-min virtual hang with a silly playlist
Irene: Love that. Short product + infra wins in the all-hands. Also, send remote folks a $15 snack voucher. ops-bot please.
ops-bot: hr-bot: Voucher workflow triggered for remote headcount; announcement scheduled in #announcements at 09:00 PT (automated)
Jamal: Poll: cake :cake: or savory pies :pie:? react to vote
Priya: :cake:
Leo: :pie:
Irene: :cake: (ordering GF option too)
Design-bot: posting "12M club" badge options to #design-review for quick thumbs-up (automated)
Jamal: Also: tiny tradition idea  each milestone we pick a 10s soundbite (kazoo, trumpet, applause). I volunteer for kazoo captain
Priya: Kazoo captain = highest honor. I will make a kazoo track and upload it for the virtual hang
Leo: Can marketing make a quick banner we can share externally? pinged them
Irene: Thank you everyone. This was a team effort, one for the books. Photos/videos welcome for the org timeline :camera_with_flash:
Priya: Proud! Also who wants to join the last-10min kazoo rehearsal? (remote + in-person)
Jamal: Count me in. See you at the micro-all-hands :raised_hands:
